minimumManualValidationPlan.workflowPolicy: The root-authorized minimal implementation reuses registered ci.yml with a default-false workflow_dispatch boolean macos27. Only a manual dispatch with this flag uses xcode-27 and adds native/universal validation. Default push, PR and false-flag dispatch behavior stays on macos-26; release workflows stay unchanged.
minimumManualValidationPlan.workflowPermissions: contents: read; checkout existing pinned checkout action with persist-credentials:false; no signing environment or release/token imports
minimumManualValidationPlan.sourceIdentity: Check out one frozen reviewed commit; retain git rev-parse HEAD with actual runner/OS/SDK identity. Do not accept a different source or assume the workflow label pins image bytes.
minimumManualValidationPlan.developerDirectorySetup: Only in the macos27 dispatch path, validate this documented directory and export it for subsequent steps using GITHUB_ENV. Do not set an empty DEVELOPER_DIR for the default path or silently fall back to a beta Xcode.
minimumManualValidationPlan.expectedPreflight: Actual macOS major version 27, arm64, selected Xcode major version 27 and macOS SDK major version 27, recording exact versions. Currently documented stable default is Xcode/SDK 27.0. A mismatch fails environment validation; it is not an app regression.
minimumManualValidationPlan.universalBuildProof: This existing no-argument entrypoint builds arm64 and x86_64 App/helper slices, combines them, checks architectures/minimum deployment/signatures with verify_release.sh --build-only, and removes disposable build output. Do not use --keep-build, install a PKG, or publish a rebuilt 4.3.22 artifact.
minimumManualValidationPlan.nativeFeasibility: Existing macos-helper-install.yml already runs these exact scripts directly on hosted macOS 26. On xcode-27, attempt them in the runner's own GUI session; do not create nested VMs. A logged-in WindowServer session on this preview image is not established by its software README alone.
acceptanceMarkers: Require all three native runs to exit 0 and each emit ALL_INTERACTION_CHECKS_PASSED.
RUNNABLE_CHECKS_PASSED_SOME_SKIPPED, SCREEN_LOCKED_CHECKS_SKIPPED, exit 2 or absent GUI is not full native acceptance.
Require ANIMATION_STRESS_PASSED iterations=20000 and exit 0 for the stress run; this is lifecycle verification, not a measured whole-app speedup.
Require Swift/Python suite summaries with actual failure/skip counts; never convert preview infrastructure failure into an app pass.
minimumManualValidationPlan.cleanupAndEvidence: Reuse each script's local_cleanup.sh/run_owned.py ownership, unique test bundle/defaults/container and bounded execution. Preserve only source/environment identities, logs and completion markers. Upload only narrow evidence, not a runnable .app or full environment dump. Verify owned scratch/process/registration/preference/container/mount cleanup even after failure; use shell pipefail if tee retains logs.
minimumManualValidationPlan.implementationStatus: Implemented the root-authorized minimal opt-in flag in ci.yml; targeted workflow tests and YAML/shell syntax checks passed. Root owns commit/push/dispatch; no job was dispatched by this agent.

remainingLimits: Public-preview infrastructure can queue or fail independently of the app and is not stable release infrastructure.
No macOS 27 Intel runner is listed; cross-building an x86_64 slice on arm64 is compilation evidence, not an Intel execution test.
Hosted virtual machines cannot establish successful physical battery/SMC measurements. Preserve that hardware validation limit.
The existing interaction suite does not install the privileged helper; a green native run does not prove a full macOS 27 PKG/helper/login lifecycle.
This is documented availability, not a capacity reservation or proof that a workflow run has succeeded.
